title: AI Meeting Tool — Backend Changeset
description: The single data contract the engine emits and the dashboard, apply layer and n8n consume. One changeset per meeting run. Prose fields (title/detail/summary) are LLM-generated; ids, tiers, counts and every `write` target are computed deterministically in code. Capture source, model and backend can all change without touching this file.

id.description: uuid we mint on ingest; primary key of public.meetings

externalId.description: the recorder's own id (zoom uuid, fathom id, recall bot id) — unique, so a retried webhook cannot create a second meeting

source.description: which capture adapter produced this. `meet` = poll-drive.js reading a Google Meet "Notes by Gemini" doc, which is the normal path; the rest are fallbacks.

brand.description: resolved client/brand name — the Brand Brain row this meeting is about. null = unresolved, which forces every write item to `blocked`

brandRecordId.description: public.brand_brain.id, resolved via that table's own brand_name/client_name/aliases matcher — the only thing writers key on

role.description: resolved from INTERNAL_HANDLES, same idea as the Figma digest. A client directive outranks an internal musing.

model.description: OpenRouter model that did the extraction

sha256.description: hash of the normalized transcript text; re-ingesting identical content is a no-op

narrative.description: 3-6 sentences: what the meeting was for and what changed as a result

items.description: Everything worth carrying out of the meeting. An item either proposes a backend write or is informational (write: null).

dropped.description: Items the model produced that code rejected, kept for tuning. The most important field is `reason` — a rising `no-evidence` count means the prompt or the model is drifting.

reason.description: `unresolved-brand` was removed: not knowing which client a fact belongs to stops it being WRITTEN to a client record, but it is still recorded in the meeting log. Nothing is discarded for lack of a brand match.

id.description: sha1(meetingId + type + writeTarget + normalizedValue), 16 hex chars. The idempotency key: meeting_applied.item_id is unique on it, so re-running a meeting or double-clicking Apply writes once.

title.description: one line a human can accept or reject at a glance

detail.description: the fuller version, including any within-meeting reversal

evidence.description: MANDATORY. No quote, no item — reconcile.js drops anything whose quote is not present in the transcript. This is the single rule that keeps invented facts out of Brand Brain.

atSec.description: offset into the recording, so a reviewer can jump to it

confidence.description: the model's own estimate — an INPUT to tiering, never the decision

tier.description: computed by tierOf() in code. auto = applied without a human. review = shown as a diff, needs a click. blocked = a human must do it by hand (money/legal/compliance, unresolved brand, or no confident target).

supersedes.description: ids of earlier items in this same meeting that this statement appears to reverse

supersededBy.description: id of a later item that appears to reverse this one. Both items are kept deliberately — subject matching is fuzzy, so a false match must never delete a real decision. A flagged item is forced to tier=review and a human picks the winner.

dueDate.description: absolute date; 'next Tuesday' is resolved against meeting.startedAt at extraction time

write.description: null = informational only, nothing is written anywhere.

target.description: which writer in engine/targets/ handles it

op.description: set = replace a field (never auto if the field is populated). append = add to a text field / log. create = new row.

field.description: Brand Brain column name; must be in the allow-list in targets/brand-brain.js or the item is dropped as unknown-field

recordKey.description: how the writer finds the row, e.g. { recordId } = public.brand_brain.id

previousValue.description: filled in at diff time by changeset.js from the live backend, so the dashboard can show old -> new. null = the field was empty.
